about: Expected-outcome table for tests/repl_send_battery.sh. Authority: the M-x cell-send contract in the source REPL documentation 'M-x cell-send contract (python)' (contract = its numbered items) and the operator rulings of 2026-10-02 ('DO NOT SKIP LINES TO PASS INTO REPL'; M-x is a faithful pipe: IPython ends as if the file ran top to bottom; a cell continued by a deeper next cell is held; indented `# %%` splits cells; iron out of scope). Each step feeds `keys` through the real mapping (after placing the cursor, when given). `source` = the fixture lines the payload must carry, every line in order (indentation may shift unless `verbatim`). `expect` = what the real IPython must report afterwards: state idle (ran, back at In[]) or waiting (held at a continuation prompt); names that must exist; values = expression -> repr; absent names; errors IPython must raise (default none).

cases.structure: first cell of a module ends with a bare `if __name__ == "__main__":`; the guard's body is the next, indented cell; the cell after that is back at top level
cases.decision: the next cell starts deeper than this one, so the module cell (ending in the bare guard) is held; the body cell continues it unshifted and the whole block runs; the following cell is dedented and runs at top level
cases.purpose: every line of a module cell ending in a bare __main__ guard reaches IPython, IPython holds the guard open, the body cell completes it, the next cell runs at top level

cases.structure: a `__main__` guard with its body, split into two cells by an indented `    # %%`; blank lines, a lambda; last line indented
cases.decision: an indented `# %%` is a cell boundary; the guard cell is held because the next sub-cell starts deeper; that sub-cell continues the guard unshifted and the guard runs
cases.purpose: a guard body split by an indented `# %%` runs as one block once its second part is sent, blank lines included

cases.structure: body-only cell: leading blank line, column-0 `# SECTION:` comment, indented statements, a multi-line call whose `)` reaches column 0 after the shift
cases.decision: the shift is taken from the first CODE line (not the comment); a column-0 closing bracket continues the call
cases.purpose: a SECTION-headed body cell is shifted left by its first code line and its multi-line call stays one statement

cases.structure: def nested in the guard body: if/else, for + if/else, a blank line inside the def, multi-line prints, return
cases.decision: nested blocks keep their relative indentation after the shift; a blank line inside the def does not end it; `else` stays attached
cases.purpose: a nested def with if/else and for/if/else inside survives the shift and behaves as written

cases.structure: body-only `if` / blank line / `elif` / `else` chain with a multi-line call
cases.decision: after the shift `elif`/`else` sit at column 0 after a blank line and must stay part of the same if-statement
cases.purpose: an if/elif/else chain with a blank line before elif runs as one statement and takes the right branch

cases.structure: try / except A: raise / blank line / except B with an f-string concatenation and a nested dict literal
cases.decision: a second `except` after a blank line continues the same try; nested brackets span many lines
cases.purpose: a try with two except clauses separated by a blank line runs as one statement and the right handler fires

cases.structure: try/except/raise, then a sibling if-block holding a for/if, an `# end` comment and a whitespace-only line at the end
cases.decision: two compound statements in a row; a trailing comment and whitespace-only line must not stop the cell executing
cases.purpose: a try block followed by a sibling if-block both run and the trailing comment lines do not leave IPython waiting

cases.structure: a decorated def nested in the guard body, then a call to it
cases.decision: the decorator line opens the definition; the call after it is a new statement
cases.purpose: a decorated nested def is defined with its decorator applied and the call after it runs

cases.structure: class with a nested def and for-loop, blank lines inside the class, statements, then a with-block, then statements
cases.decision: class/def nesting and a with-block survive the shift; the blank line inside the class does not end it
cases.purpose: a class body with a nested method and loop, and a later with-block, all run as written

cases.structure: a parenthesised conditional expression whose `if`/`else` lines sit inside the parens, then a with-block holding a for-loop, then an `# end` comment
cases.decision: an `else` inside brackets is part of an expression, not a clause; the closing `)` reaches column 0
cases.purpose: a multi-line conditional expression in parentheses and a with/for block run as written

cases.structure: a cell that ends inside a while-loop body (leading blank line)
cases.decision: a cell ending inside an indented block needs the execution newline; no manual Enter
cases.purpose: a cell ending inside a while body executes without a manual Enter

cases.structure: a for-loop cell, then a cell whose first line is indented deeper than the lines below it (the file continues the loop body across the `# %%`)
cases.decision: the second cell's deeper first line continues the loop from the cell above: the loop cell is held, the second cell continues it with the loop cell's shift, and the dedented rest runs after the loop (as the file reads)
cases.purpose: a cell whose first line is deeper than the rest joins the loop held open from the cell above and runs as the file reads

cases.structure: a guard body split into sub-cells by INDENTED `    # %%` markers; cursor in the middle sub-cell
cases.decision: an indented `# %%` is a cell boundary (ruling 2026-10-02): <M-x> sends only the sub-cell around the cursor
cases.purpose: <M-x> inside an indented `# %%` sub-cell sends only that sub-cell

cases.structure: a cell holding only commented-out (indented) code
cases.decision: nothing to execute: IPython must neither error nor be left waiting
cases.purpose: a comment-only cell leaves IPython idle with no error

cases.structure: a cell (opened by an indented `        # %%`) ending in a non-guard `if ...:` header with no body; the next cell is at the header's own indentation (a sibling, not its body), so the source itself is invalid there
cases.decision: the next cell does not start deeper, so nothing is held by the editor; IPython itself waits on the bodiless header, and the sibling cell sent next is IPython's IndentationError to report
cases.purpose: a bodiless `if` header leaves IPython waiting, and a following sibling cell is not silently made its body

cases.structure: <M-X> on the guard's SETUP `# SECTION:` block: indented body, blank lines, and the block runs past a column-0 `# %%` delimiter up to the next SECTION marker
cases.decision: a SECTION payload spans a cell delimiter; send_current_section appends a protocol CR; a body-only block is shifted and runs
cases.purpose: <M-X> sends the whole SECTION block, delimiter line included, and it runs

cases.structure: <M-X> on an INDENTED `    # SECTION:` block: blank lines, comments, an f-string, ending in an indented `    # %%` just above the next indented SECTION marker
cases.decision: indented SECTION markers bound the block; a block ending in a comment still executes
cases.purpose: <M-X> on an indented SECTION block sends exactly that block and it runs

cases.structure: visual-line selection (<M-e>) of a for/if/else sub-block from inside the def body
cases.decision: a selection is shifted by its own first line, not by the cell's; it ends inside an else-block and must execute
cases.purpose: a visual selection of a nested for/if/else runs with its own indentation

cases.structure: a cell that is one indented line
cases.decision: a single indented line is sent (shifted or not) and runs
cases.purpose: a one-line indented cell runs

cases.structure: body-only cell holding a triple-quoted string whose text sits at column 0 and contains a blank line
cases.decision: the shift must not touch string lines at column 0, and the blank line inside the string must be kept
cases.purpose: a triple-quoted string reaches IPython with its exact text, blank line included

cases.structure: column-0 imports and definitions followed by a guard with a body split across cells; two successive presses from line 1
cases.decision: hold the whole top cell without executing any imports; continue the guard unshifted, then execute; missing real dependencies remain the hermetic IPython error
cases.purpose: reds when the top cell executes before its indented next cell on two successive <M-x> presses

cases.structure: column-0 imports and definitions followed by a guard with a body split across cells; explicit cursor jump to line 279
cases.decision: hold the whole top cell without executing any imports; continue the guard unshifted, then execute; missing real dependencies remain the hermetic IPython error
cases.purpose: reds when the top cell executes before its indented next cell after an explicit jump to line 279
